# ssp_site_settings (Resource)

Manages the per-site SSP feature settings for an already-onboarded site.

These settings are created automatically as part of the site onboarding workflow (`ssp_site`) — this resource does not create or delete them, only configures the subset that is editable via API. Configuring a setting here does not activate or deploy the corresponding feature; it only adjusts that feature's per-site behavior.

Corresponds to `GET/PUT /ssp/sites/{site-id}/settings`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `site_id` (String) ID of the onboarded site (`ssp_site.id`) these settings belong to.

### Optional

- `is_intelligence_enabled` (Boolean) Site-specific setting for the Intelligence feature.
- `is_metrics_enabled` (Boolean) Site-specific setting for the Metrics feature.
- `is_mps_enabled` (Boolean) Site-specific setting for the Malware Prevention Service feature.
- `is_ndr_enabled` (Boolean) Site-specific setting for the NDR feature.
- `is_rule_analysis_enabled` (Boolean) Site-specific setting for the Rule Analysis feature.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the site settings object, as returned by the API.
